content:
The body is definitively trapped on the notice board tile at (2,7). I've now exhaustively tried:
- All four cardinal directions (short and long holds)
- Diagonal holds
- The walk helper (pathfinder confirms "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)")
- KeyE interactions in all directions
- Waiting across multiple days

None free the body. The pathfinder itself reports there is no walkable path out because the notice board blocks the tile the body occupies. This is an unrecoverable state — the body cannot move, so it cannot gather materials, reach the workbench, or craft the Crown.

The task genuinely cannot be completed from this trapped state. I've recorded the durable fact. There is nothing further my tools can do.

DONE
